name: Rolex Rings Ltd
title: Rolex Rings Ltd - 543325 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR1,144 cr despite US exports down ~30%; management guides FY27 growth 15–17% and utilisation only 62–63%, with a 25% US tariff now accepted by customers.

utilisation.quote: we are in the range of 62% to 63% of utilization of my available or achievable capacity

capex.quote: there would be there a minimum INR30 crores to INR40 crores bare minimum capex plus maintenance capex

triggers.label: Utilisation 62–63% — spare capacity
triggers.quote: we are in the range of 62% to 63% of utilization of my available or achievable capacity

triggers.label: FY27 growth 15–17% guided
triggers.quote: we are expecting somewhere about 15%, 17% growth in fiscal '27

triggers.label: Inventory days stretched incl. in-transit
triggers.quote: considering that sales in transit, it would be touching 150 or 160 days

triggers.label: US orders expected to recover from Q1FY27
triggers.quote: we expect U.S. order flows to resume meaningfully from Q1 of current fiscal

guidance.quote: we are expecting somewhere about 15%, 17% growth in fiscal '27
a bit on a higher -- a high-teen growth in the fiscal 2028
operating EBITDA would not be less than 20.5%, 21% kind of thing
you may expect overall gross margin to the extent of in the range of 49 to 53 percentage

guidance.value: INR30-40 cr minimum plus maintenance (~INR50 cr)
guidance.quote: there would be there a minimum INR30 crores to INR40 crores bare minimum capex plus maintenance capex

prior_guidance_check.metric: INR1.75 bn order inflow conversion to FY26 revenue
prior_guidance_check.quote: out of that INR175 crores, maybe INR75 crores, INR80-odd crores business, something we were able to add into my fiscal '26 business

red_flags.label: Customs duty receivables unrecovered (~INR22 cr, ~50% receivable)
red_flags.quote: almost 50% of that are yet to be receivable from the customers

red_flags.label: Sales in transit inflating inventory days 150-160
red_flags.quote: considering that sales in transit, it would be touching 150 or 160 days

red_flags.label: Several US programs on hold; INR175 cr order conversion only partly met
red_flags.quote: a couple of programs are still on hold at U.S.

evasions.quote: I don't want to name any serious competitor
we are in the thought process to even offer further dividend
